postings.title: AI Programmer Intern
postings.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.
ENGINEERING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of engineering experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

AI PROGRAMMER INTERN

What You'll Do

The Epic Games UE Al team is looking for a Research Engineering Intern who is excited about machine learning and artificial intelligence. Epic Games creates and deploys advanced computer vision, computer graphics and machine learning technologies to transform the production and consumption of digital media. This includes physics-based simulation, ML-based character animation, neural and inverse rendering, and automated generative animation techniques, among others. At Epic we research, develop and deploy these technologies for Unreal Engine and other Epic products.

In this role, you will

- Assist with prototyping machine learning and generative approaches for game content creation as part of a defined project with guidance from a mentor

- Support experiments by preparing data, running tests, collecting results, and helping document observations

- Assist with implementing and testing research concepts using Python and relevant machine learning tools

- Read and discuss research papers with team members to develop familiarity with current approaches and techniques

- Work with your mentor and immediate team to support ongoing research and development projects

- Communicate progress, ask questions, and incorporate feedback while working through assigned tasks

- Share your work and key learnings through regular updates and a final presentation to the team

What we're looking for

- Currently enrolled in an undergraduate (Bachelor's) or Master's degree program in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline

- Foundational programming skills in Python, with C++ experience considered a plus

- Introductory experience with a machine learning framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow through coursework, academic projects, or personal projects

- Foundational understanding of machine learning concepts and an interest in exploring their practical applications

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an eagerness to learn new tools, techniques, and technologies

- Knowledge of, or strong interest in, one or more of the following areas: real-time graphics, computer vision, machine learning, animation, large language models, speech recognition, speech synthesis, linguistics, performance capture, or 3D reconstruction

- Exposure to academic research, relevant coursework, personal projects, or open-source contributions in machine learning, computer vision, computer graphics, or related technical areas

- Familiarity with Unreal Engine or another game engine is a plus

- Interest in games, digital humans, or real-time content creation

- Ability to communicate progress, ask questions, collaborate with others, and incorporate feedback

This internship has a flexible start date in 2027. Recruitment will be ongoing until teams find an ideal match. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the posting location for the duration of the internship. For more information about Epic’s Early Career Program, visit epicgames.com/earlycareers. This is going to be Epic!

ABOUT US

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

postings.title: Cinematics Director
postings.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

Cinematic Director, Fortnite Ecosystem – Cinematic Trailers

What We Do

In the Cinematics Team, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible in realtime. We are in the early stages of this growth in realtime quality work and we are growing quickly and implementing various techniques and ideas to improve what can be done in Unreal Engine. Our team is one of the few at the forefront of delivering innovation, through cinematic quality visuals.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for a collaborative Cinematic Director to join our Fortnite cinematics team who can help craft high-impact trailers and short-form content that connects with the Fortnite audience.

We're looking for a hands-on filmmaker who uses Unreal Engine as a creative tool and is excited to jump into Sequencer to explore, iterate, and build.

Tone matters as much as craft. Strong comedic instincts and a feel for playful, irreverent, character-driven storytelling - someone who understands timing, performance, and visual comedy while still delivering cinematic scale and polish.

This is a highly collaborative role working alongside our existing directors and discipline leads to brainstorm, rapidly pitch, and bring ideas to life. You'll manage multiple trailers simultaneously while incorporating feedback from Marketing, Art Direction, Game Direction, and other partners without compromising the creative intent.

In this role, you will

- Collaborate with our directors and discipline leads to define the creative vision, story, tone, and visual language for Fortnite cinematic trailers and short-form content.

- Develop and pitch original story and comedy ideas, taking them from early concept through final delivery.

- Work hands-on in Unreal Engine 5, building and iterating sequences in Sequencer.

- Translate scripts and storyboards into compelling shots through composition, camera movement, performance, pacing, and visual comedy.

- Manage multiple projects simultaneously while synthesizing feedback from Marketing, Art Direction, Game Direction, and other creative partners.

- Partner across Animation, Layout, Lighting, FX, Production, and Technical Art to bring the creative vision to life.

- Collaborate with the Animation Director on performance and motion capture, and oversee scene assembly in Unreal Engine.

- Communicate ideas quickly through storyboards, draw-overs, animatics, rip-o-matics, and other visual tools.

- Explore emerging tools and workflows that help the team iterate quickly and push creative quality.

What we're looking for

- A portfolio or reel demonstrating short-form directing, character-driven storytelling, strong comedic instincts, and visual storytelling.

- Directing XP across animation, cinematic trailers, commercials, digital shorts, games, or other short-form entertainment.

- Strong cinematic fundamentals, including shot design, composition, camera movement, editing, pacing, and performance.

- Hands-on XP with Unreal Engine and Sequencer; familiarity with Control Rig workflows.

- A collaborative mindset and comfort developing ideas through brainstorming, rapid iteration, and shared creative ownership.

- A distinct creative point of view and willingness to challenge assumptions while remaining open to feedback.

- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and adapt quickly as creative direction and priorities evolve.

- Ability to communicate creative intent across Animation, Layout, Lighting, FX, and technical teams.

Nice to have

- Experience directing actors, performance capture, or motion capture sessions.

- Background in animation, storyboarding, editing, or visual development.

- Familiarity with modeling, skinning, rigging, or technical art.

- Interest in emerging animation and filmmaking technologies, including procedural and AI-assisted workflows.

- Scripting or technical art knowledge, including Python or Blueprints.

This role is open to multiple locations across the US (including CA, NYC, & WA). 

Pay Transparency Information

The expected annual base pay range(s) for this position are detailed below. Each base pay range is relevant only for individuals who are residents of or will be expected to work within the specified locale. Compensation varies based on a variety of factors, which include (but aren’t limited to) things such as skills and competencies, qualifications, knowledge, and experience. In addition to base pay, most employees are eligible to participate in Epic’s generous benefit plans and discretionary incentive programs (subject to the terms of those plans or programs).

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

Our intent is to cover all things that are medically necessary and improve the quality of life. We pay 100% of the premiums for both you and your dependents. Our coverage includes Medical, Dental, a Vision HRA, Long Term Disability, Life Insurance & a 401k with competitive match. We also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents. Throughout the year we celebrate our employees with events and company-wide paid breaks. We offer unlimited PTO and sick time and recognize individuals for 7 years of employment with a paid sabbatical.

New York City Base Pay Range
$229,576—$382,626 USD

California Base Pay Range
$224,793—$374,655 USD

Washington Base Pay Range
$224,793—$374,655 USD

ABOUT US

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

The Epic Communications team advances the company’s narrative and represents Epic products and the company vision to external and internal audiences globally. We create positive relationships and engagement strategies with a wide range of audiences, including media, investors, influencers, and policymakers.

COMMUNICATIONS INTERN

We're looking for a Communications Intern to join the Comms and Community team. Within this team, we keep press, players, developers, and the world informed and build strong reputations for the games, tools, and tech Epic Games makes.

In this role, you will help prepare plans for new product and feature launches for the Fortnite ecosystem, Rocket League, as well as our developer platforms. In this role, you will

- Contribute to the development of plans and materials for news moments, including: writing messaging for different audiences, helping anticipate potential reactions and prepare for reactive questions, organizing trackers and contacts for media outreach, contributing to social media planning, and reporting on coverage, audience reception, and media feedback

- Help track Epic's day-to-day media coverage, monitor social media sentiment and run analysis, bringing insights to the team

postings.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.
LEGAL

What We Do

Epic's multi-specialized team of attorneys and legal professionals partner across our organization to provide legal solutions as well as consult and inform on the products we build and games we develop.

What You'll Do

Epic's regulatory lawyers advise the company on laws and regulations worldwide. We partner with Public Policy to monitor regulatory developments and support advocacy on regulatory design; with Product Counsel on new products and their regulatory requirements; and with Compliance on the design and operation of our regulatory compliance program. We also help manage the company's response to regulatory inquiries, investigations and RFIS.

In this role, you will

- Advise Product Counsel, Compliance and Legal leadership on global laws and regulations, with the focus of this role being on online safety frameworks such as the UK Online Safety Act and EU Digital Services Act

- Monitor and analyse draft legislation and regulatory proposals, supporting Public Policy's advocacy efforts

- Advise Product Counsel on new products and features and their regulatory requirements

- Support Compliance in the operation of our regulatory compliance program and compliance strategies

- Help manage the company's response to regulatory oversight, such as supervisory meetings and RFIs

What we're looking for

- Qualified attorney with 5+ years experience working in regulatory compliance, either within a regulatory body, in-house or at a law firm

- Experience with online safety regulation in the UK and/or EU

- Knowledge of the tech industry; familiarity with video games is an advantage

- Ability/flexibility to work US Eastern time hours

- Comfort working with multiple stakeholders, navigating complex issues, and leading high-impact projects

- Sound judgement and decision-making in ambiguous situations where clear guidance may be limited or non-existent

- Proactive, independent and reliable, with the ability to deliver under tight timeframes in a fast-paced environment

- Excellent interpersonal skills and a collaborative approach

This role is open to multiple locations in Europe.

postings.title: Cyber Defense Operations Director
postings.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.
INFOSEC

What We Do

Keep Epic’s networks, hardware, and people safe from security risks. Install security measures and operate software to protect systems and information infrastructure, including firewalls and encryption programs. Document issues as they arise and assess & report any impact caused.

What You'll Do

Epic's Cyber Defense Operations team protects one of the world's largest player communities, as well as the people, infrastructure, and technology that support it. As Cyber Defense Operations Director, you will own Epic's detection and response function end-to-end, leading the teams who detect, investigate, and respond to threats across the company. You will set the long-term vision for security operations, build an organization that scales with Epic's growth, and lead the shift to automated, Al-assisted operations so the team can focus on the threats that matter most. This is a player-coach role: you will lead from the front, stay hands-on alongside the team, and hold yourself to the same high standard you set for others.

In this role, you will

- Build and lead the Cyber Defense Operations organization as a hands-on player-coach: hire and develop strong analysts, set the org structure, and stay in the work on investigations, detection, and major incidents. Coach the team through real cases, put their growth first, and clear the obstacles that slow them down

- Set the multi-year strategy and roadmap for detection, response, automation, and tooling, aligned with Epic's risk profile, business priorities, and Information Security leadership goals

- Act as the senior incident lead for Epic's most significant security events, directing response across programming, legal, privacy, communications, and executive leadership, and briefing senior leaders on impact and risk

- Own detection and response coverage across cloud, corporate, endpoint, identity, and production environments, directing investment toward the threats that pose the most risk to Epic

- Champion automation and AI-agent workflows across security operations, partnering with security programming leadership to set guardrails, validation standards, and where human review is required

- Run Cyber Defense Operations as a business and a partner to the rest of Epic: shape the budget and vendor portfolio (managed-service partners, SLAs, contracts, and build/buy/retire calls on tooling), define and report the metrics that show how well we protect Epic (time to detect, time to respond, coverage, alert quality), keep playbooks, on-call, and escalation paths tested and ready to scale, and build partnerships across Epic so emerging threats turn into coordinated action

What we're looking for

- 8+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, or threat detection, including 6+ years leading security teams

- A track record of building and scaling a SOC or detection and response organization, including org design, hiring, and developing leaders

- Strong technical grounding in SIEM and EDR platforms (e.g., Splunk, Google SecOps, CrowdStrike, etc.), enough to guide design and tooling decisions and challenge technical approaches

- Deep understanding of attacker tradecraft and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, and how to use them to prioritize coverage and investment

- Experience leading response to major incidents in cloud environments (AWS and/or GCP), SaaS, and identity platforms, including executive and regulatory communication

- Experience leading automation and SOAR programs at scale, and a clear point of view on applying Al to security operations responsibly

- Experience shaping budgets and managing vendors and managed security service providers, including contracts, SLAs, and performance

- A calm, accountable, people-first leader: decisive under pressure, clear when explaining risk and trade-offs to executives in briefings and incident reports, hands-on alongside the team on investigations, detections, and incidents, and willing to challenge how things have always been done. You own outcomes, follow through, take responsibility when things go wrong, and measure your success by the success of your team and the people they protect

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees and dependents and offer coverage for supplemental medical, dental, vision, critical illness, telemedicine, Life and AD&D, long term disability insurance as well as weekly indemnity (short term disability) and a retirement savings plan with a competitive employer match. In addition to the EAP (employee assistance program), we also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents.

postings.title: Cyber Defense Operations Director
postings.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.
INFOSEC

What We Do

Keep Epic’s networks, hardware, and people safe from security risks. Install security measures and operate software to protect systems and information infrastructure, including firewalls and encryption programs. Document issues as they arise and assess & report any impact caused.

What You'll Do

Epic's Cyber Defense Operations team protects one of the world's largest player communities, as well as the people, infrastructure, and technology that support it. As Cyber Defense Operations Director, you will own Epic's detection and response function end-to-end, leading the teams who detect, investigate, and respond to threats across the company. You will set the long-term vision for security operations, build an organization that scales with Epic's growth, and lead the shift to automated, Al-assisted operations so the team can focus on the threats that matter most. This is a player-coach role: you will lead from the front, stay hands-on alongside the team, and hold yourself to the same high standard you set for others.

In this role, you will

- Build and lead the Cyber Defense Operations organization as a hands-on player-coach: hire and develop strong analysts, set the org structure, and stay in the work on investigations, detection, and major incidents. Coach the team through real cases, put their growth first, and clear the obstacles that slow them down

- Set the multi-year strategy and roadmap for detection, response, automation, and tooling, aligned with Epic's risk profile, business priorities, and Information Security leadership goals

- Act as the senior incident lead for Epic's most significant security events, directing response across programming, legal, privacy, communications, and executive leadership, and briefing senior leaders on impact and risk

- Own detection and response coverage across cloud, corporate, endpoint, identity, and production environments, directing investment toward the threats that pose the most risk to Epic

- Champion automation and AI-agent workflows across security operations, partnering with security programming leadership to set guardrails, validation standards, and where human review is required

- Run Cyber Defense Operations as a business and a partner to the rest of Epic: shape the budget and vendor portfolio (managed-service partners, SLAs, contracts, and build/buy/retire calls on tooling), define and report the metrics that show how well we protect Epic (time to detect, time to respond, coverage, alert quality), keep playbooks, on-call, and escalation paths tested and ready to scale, and build partnerships across Epic so emerging threats turn into coordinated action

What we're looking for

- 8+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, or threat detection, including 6+ years leading security teams

- A track record of building and scaling a SOC or detection and response organization, including org design, hiring, and developing leaders

- Strong technical grounding in SIEM and EDR platforms (e.g., Splunk, Google SecOps, CrowdStrike, etc.), enough to guide design and tooling decisions and challenge technical approaches

- Deep understanding of attacker tradecraft and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, and how to use them to prioritize coverage and investment

- Experience leading response to major incidents in cloud environments (AWS and/or GCP), SaaS, and identity platforms, including executive and regulatory communication

- Experience leading automation and SOAR programs at scale, and a clear point of view on applying Al to security operations responsibly

- Experience shaping budgets and managing vendors and managed security service providers, including contracts, SLAs, and performance

- A calm, accountable, people-first leader: decisive under pressure, clear when explaining risk and trade-offs to executives in briefings and incident reports, hands-on alongside the team on investigations, detections, and incidents, and willing to challenge how things have always been done. You own outcomes, follow through, take responsibility when things go wrong, and measure your success by the success of your team and the people they protect

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

Our intent is to cover all things that are medically necessary and improve the quality of life. We pay 100% of the premiums for both you and your dependents. Our coverage includes Medical, Dental, a Vision HRA, Long Term Disability, Life Insurance & a 401k with competitive match. We also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents. Throughout the year we celebrate our employees with events and company-wide paid breaks. We offer unlimited PTO and sick time and recognize individuals for 7 years of employment with a paid sabbatical.

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. PRODUCTION

What We Do

Whether it’s driving a vision from start to finish or collaborating with teams to inspire and deliver projects of Epic quality, Epic’s production teams take pride in consistently delivering world-class products and experiences.

What You'll Do

Epic's third-party content group brings the world's best-known entertainment and gaming IP into Fortnite as creator-enabled experiences built with Unreal Editor for Fortnite (UEFN), funding and shipping a growing slate of licensed and partner titles through external studios and vendors while operating the live platform where that content is discovered and grows.

As the program scales with more titles, larger partnerships and major launches ahead, this role will be the production spine of that growth, leading production across the licensed IP slate end to end, coordinating delivery with internal development and platform teams, managing production relationships with licensors and external studios, and overseeing live operations once titles launch. Working alongside design, art, PM and engineering leads, you will own launch readiness, budgets, vendor contracts and capacity plans while building and leading a production team that can scale with the slate.

In this role, you will

- Shipping and launch readiness: Own launch readiness per title, chairing weekly status across all workstreams (creator tools, island production, publishing and access, discovery placement, IP and content moderation, brand compliance, creator-facing UX, monetisation, documentation, marketing and QA), assigning owners, chasing actions and holding the quality bar

- Partner production management: Be the production face to our licensor partners, aligning on brand guidelines and content review while carrying decisions between partners, legal, business development, and the development team

- Platform liveops: Own the live operating rhythm of the platform, including release cadence, events, merchandising, discovery and monetisation health, and the feedback loop from live metrics back into the slate and roadmap

- Production team leadership: Build and run the production organisation with clear ownership, real delegation, and team ceremonies that hold up as the slate scales across UK and US timezones

- Budget, vendors and capacity: Own vendor statements of work, budget management and annual planning, capacity and staffing plans, and org design in partnership with discipline directors, while providing senior leadership with a high-level view of people, projects, and spend

- Roadmap and planning: Own the production view of the roadmap across the whole organisation, keeping priorities, sequencing and resourcing aligned across teams, disciplines and partners

- AI adoption and process change: Lead the charge through a revolutionary period in game development, helping the team adopt AI where it makes a real difference, and evolve our production practices as the technology matures

What we're looking for

- Significant experience shipping games or live services from inside a first-party or internal development organisation

- Experience managing multiple external partners in parallel (licensors, publishers or studios), including publishing production

- Experience leading live operations for a platform or live service at scale

- Demonstrated experience owning multi-million dollar budgets, vendor management and capacity planning, with the ability to present and defend them at the executive level

- Proven ability to establish production methodologies and standards that drive adoption across teams and the broader organization

- Strong people leader who builds effective teams, structures, and empowers others through delegation, while being able to grow a production organisation and protect team health as the slate scales

- Calm, low-ego and empathetic leader who builds trust across teams, executives and external partners, navigating ambiguity and complex challenges with clarity, sound judgment and strong communication

- Strong strategic judgment, with the ability to see the bigger picture, navigate competing priorities, and make thoughtful trade-offs

- Passion for user-generated content and creator communities is a strong advantage

- Comfortable collaborating closely with teams and partners across the UK and US time zones

This role is open to multiple locations across North America & Europe (including NYC).

$219,811—$322,389 USD

PRODUCT MANAGEMENT

What We Do

Product Management partners with game development, publishing, marketing, and platform teams to provide a data and market-driven view of product strategy that aligns with business goals. As part of Epic’s Growth Team, we use our product expertise to identify and drive growth levers to grow our player base and business.

What You'll Do

As a Director of Product Management, you will be a key leader within the Discovery product org. You will help define the strategy and flywheel of the Discovery system, working closely with Development, Design, and Data Science teams to ship features and optimize systems that connect players with the right content at the right time. You will translate high-level strategic goals into actionable roadmaps, write detailed requirements, and drive cross-functional execution. You will partner with marketing, content strategy, and creator initiatives teams to ensure their needs are reflected in the product.

In this role, you will

- Own product strategy and execution for defined areas of the Discover surface, developing roadmaps that improve player discovery and drive growth

- Write detailed business and product requirements that guide design and technical specifications, partnering directly with Development and Data Science to ship high-quality systems and features

- Develop and refine "playbooks" and operational strategies that leverage Discover features to achieve initiative goals, using data to measure effectiveness and iterate

- Build and present product and feature concepts to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, clearly articulating impact, rationale, and expected outcomes

- Drive live operations execution for Discover initiatives, ensuring consistent quality and identifying opportunities for improvement through data analysis

What we're looking for

- 5+ years of Product Management experience, with meaningful exposure to discovery systems, content platforms, recommendation engines, or large-scale consumer products

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to inform product decisions, define success metrics, and evaluate feature performance

- Passion for games and a solid understanding of growth, retention, and monetization mechanics that deliver value for players

- Interest in creator ecosystems, with the ability to understand and advocate for developers building on a platform

- Track record of shipping products in fast-paced, highly collaborative environments with multiple stakeholders

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience writing product requirement documents and presenting to senior leadership

- Experience managing or mentoring other PMs is a plus

postings.title: Engine Programmer Intern
postings.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.
ENGINEERING - GAMES

What We Do

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

ENGINE PROGRAMMER INTERN

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for an Engine Programmer Intern to join them for the 2027 season. Working on our Fortnite Online team, you'll be supporting a multitude of systems and features for our Engine and Fortnite.

If it's an online game feature, we touch it. Epic engineers wear many hats. As an intern, you are provided with a meaningful experience with high expectations for performance. If you want to build something Epic, this is the opportunity for you!

In this role, you will

- Work closely with the Fortnite Online team (FNO) by architecting, developing, and maintaining shared online gameplay technology

- Contribute to the online systems and toolsets used by licensees in the Unreal Engine as well as online features and services used by Fortnite and other games at Epic

- Develop solutions to various technical challenges from initial concept to final shipped code and ensure that it is stable for our players once released

What we're looking for

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline required, with strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills strongly desired

- Demonstrable proficiency in object-oriented programming and C++ required, with familiarity with Java considered a plus

- Demonstrable knowledge of networking, REST, and utilizing back-end services with resiliency in mind

postings.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.
INFOSEC

What We Do

Keep Epic’s networks, hardware, and people safe from security risks. Install security measures and operate software to protect systems and information infrastructure, including firewalls and encryption programs. Document issues as they arise and assess & report any impact caused.

What You'll Do

We're seeking a Gaming Threat Intelligence Analyst to identify, investigate, and disrupt the people who cheat, defraud, or abuse Epic's games and players. You'll track cheat developers, account sellers, and fraud operations back to the people and infrastructure behind them, then work with Ecosystem Security and Legal to turn that research into mitigations, enforcement, and legal action. This role owns investigations from first lead to finished report with minimal oversight.

In this role, you will

- Investigate cheat developers, sellers and resellers, account sellers, tournament cheaters, DDoS providers, and exploit developers targeting Epic's games

- Identify the people, networks, and infrastructure behind cheat products and fraud schemes, not only the products themselves

- Investigate fraud and abuse across the ecosystem, including V-Bucks fraud, Support-A-Creator fraud, and map payout fraud

- Monitor cheat communities and underground markets for new features, techniques, and trends, and feed findings into technical mitigations and enforcement decisions

- Track account compromise methods and social engineering tactics used against players

- Research and maintain Epic's gaming threat landscape, including the leading threat actors, their methods, and where they are likely to move next

- Prioritize actors by impact and build evidence packages that support takedowns, payment disruption, and litigation, and support Legal throughout the legal process

- Work with external intel partners on reporting, cheat testing, and attribution, and exchange intelligence with gaming industry peers

- Support incident response with research on cheats, exploits, compromised accounts, and leaks

- Write case reports and contribute to quarterly threat reporting, and own small projects from the team backlog end to end

What we're looking for

- 4+ years of experience in threat intelligence, online investigations, anti-cheat, fraud, or trust and safety

- Working knowledge of how cheat, account selling, or fraud ecosystems operate

- Strong OSINT skills, including pivoting on handles, accounts, storefronts, payment details, domains, and hosting

- Experience with threat intelligence platforms such as Flashpoint, Recorded Future, or similar

- Comfortable querying data in SQL or Splunk, with basic Python

- Organized case management (Jira or similar) and evidence documentation that holds up to legal review

- Clear report writing for technical, legal, and leadership audiences

- Availability for on-call rotation

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for an experienced Hard Surface Outsourcing Lead to support and supervise creative hard surface content provided by outsource partners. Working alongside Hard Surface Art Leads, and reporting to the Hard Surface Cosmetics Lead, the Outsource Lead will provide front-line creative feedback for work submitted for Fortnite. Though the role will be mainly supervisory, the individual should be an experienced artist, having worked in AAA titles before, and have a solid hands-on art background, with a very strong foundation of 3D modeling for both hard and soft surfaces. The ideal candidate would be a talented 3D artist who is able to communicate equally effectively, both with outsource partners and internal teams, to ensure the timely delivery of high quality assets to the next stage in the art pipeline. Their skills will include; a keen artistic eye for ‘clean’ 3D modelling, documenting existing pipelines, creating blockouts, paintovers and exemplar assets and, ultimately, providing clear visual feedback to vendors at each stage of the process.

In this role, you will

- Work closely with the HS Cosmetics Lead and HS Art Leads to pull together clear creative direction for the assets to be created, and then ensure this information is packaged and conveyed to the Vendor as clearly as possible. Work with Directors, Production, and internal partners to evaluate, hire, and onboard vendors

- Collect or generate detailed documentation, video reference, and examples of art asset production, procedures, and engine requirements to support the external vendors

- If required, making any needed fixes to keep assets consistent and technically game ready as they’re handed off from the outsource partner

- Clearly communicating modeling and paint feedback to the outsource partner, and ensuring those creative notes and goals are met. Informing leadership in the event that isn’t happening

- Communicating and partnering with the HS implementation team ensuring outsourced assets are ingested into the pipeline and engine correctly

- When required, some amount of hands-on art production delivering assets for the project, ensuring they are familiar with and capable of working inside of the Epic pipeline

- Bug support, triage, and resolution for any art assets that have been created by the outsourcing team

What we're looking for

- Experience in shipping AAA titles across multiple platforms

- Experienced shipping 3D production assets for games in either character, weapon, or prop disciplines

- Experienced in game art asset creation in a variety of software packages including Maya, 3ds Max, Zbrush, Photoshop, Substance, etc

- Experience in modeling, creating UV's and texturing is essential

- Must be highly organized, self-driven, customer focused, and a great team player

- Must be a clear and concise communicator, able to deliver complex creative feedback across external vendor locations

- Experienced working within a team and a high pressure production environment

- You’re user-focused, passionate, solutions-focused, and innovative

Though the role will be mainly supervisory, the individual should be an experienced artist, having worked in AAA titles before, and have a solid hands-on art background, with a very strong foundation of 3D modelling for both hard and soft surfaces. The ideal candidate would be a talented 3D artist who is able to communicate equally effectively, both with outsource partners and internal teams, to ensure the timely delivery of high quality assets to the next stage in the art pipeline. - Work closely with the HS Cosmetics Lead and HS Art Leads to pull together clear creative direction for the assets to be created, and then ensure this information is packaged and conveyed to the Vendor as clearly as possible. Work with Directors, Production, and internal partners to evaluate, hire, and onboard vendors

- Collect or generate detailed documentation, video reference, and examples of art asset production, procedures, and engine requirements to support the external vendors

- If required, making any needed fixes to keep assets consistent and technically game ready as they’re handed off from the outsource partner

- Clearly communicating modeling and paint feedback to the outsource partner, and ensuring those creative notes and goals are met. Informing leadership in the event that isn’t happening

- Communicating and partnering with the HS implementation team ensuring outsourced assets are ingested into the pipeline and engine correctly

- Bug support, triage, and resolution for any art assets that have been created by the outsourcing team

What we're looking for

- Experienced shipping 3D production assets for games in either character, weapon, or prop disciplines

- Experienced in game art asset creation in a variety of software packages including Maya, 3ds Max, Zbrush, Photoshop, Substance, etc

- Experience in modeling, creating UV's and texturing is essential

- Must be highly organized, self-driven, customer focused, and a great team player

- Must be a clear and concise communicator, able to deliver complex creative feedback across external vendor locations

- Experienced working within a team and a high pressure production environment

postings.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.
MARKETING

What We Do

We deliver the most innovative gaming experiences possible to players around the world. Whether through community outreach, world-class events, or partnership integrations, the Epic Games Publishing and Marketing teams seek to surprise players with new experiences every time they drop in to play.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is seeking a highly strategic, culturally fluent, and operationally rigorous Influencer Marketing Director to lead creator and talent partnerships across Fortnite. This role will shape how creators, streamers, athletes, musicians, entertainers, and their communities connect with Fortnite through major launches, live-service moments, partnerships, and creator campaigns.

The ideal candidate combines deep fluency in the Fortnite creator ecosystem with strong strategic judgment, communication skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. This person should understand both gaming culture and broader entertainment ecosystems, and be equally comfortable building creator strategy, managing high-profile talent relationships, and navigating complex cross-functional initiatives.

In this role, you will

- Develop and lead creator and influencer strategies tied to Fortnite launches, partnerships, live-service beats, and major campaigns

- Translate brand and business objectives into measurable creator programs that drive audience engagement, conversation, and commercial impact

- Build and manage relationships with key gaming creators, streamers, athletes, entertainers, agents, and talent representatives across multiple verticals

- Lead high-profile creator and talent integrations from planning through execution, including negotiations, hospitality, experiential activations, and content coordination

- Present creator strategies, talent recommendations, and campaign plans clearly and concisely to senior leadership

- Partner cross-functionally across Paid Media, Brand Marketing, Competitive, IP Partnerships teams and external partners to deliver cohesive global campaigns

- Manage agency partners and oversee campaign execution to ensure work meets Epic’s creative, operational, and business standards

- Operate effectively across multiple high-visibility initiatives simultaneously while navigating compressed timelines, shifting priorities, and fast-moving launch environments

What we're looking for

- 8+ years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, talent relations, or cultural marketing within gaming, entertainment, sports, music, or adjacent industries

- Deep understanding of Fortnite, gaming creators, livestream culture, and the broader creator ecosystem across Twitch, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and X

- Proven experience managing high-profile creator or celebrity partnerships, including negotiations, experiential activations, hospitality, and complex partner coordination

- Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to deliver concise strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders

- Experience operating effectively in fast-paced, high-volume environments with multiple concurrent launches and evolving priorities

- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to influence teams and stakeholders within highly matrixed organizations

- Experience managing agency partners, external vendors, and regional campaign execution across global markets

- Demonstrated operational rigor, sound judgment, and attention to detail, with the ability to balance creative thinking and business impact

What We Do

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of programming experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

We are seeking an experienced Lead Gameplay Programmer to direct gameplay teams within Rocket League. They will be responsible for leading the gameplay programming team and collaborating and iterating with gameplay programmers, game designers, producers, and artists. They will play a critical role in feature development for Rocket League.

In this role, you will

- Manage a team of seasoned gameplay programmers and be the primary hub of communication and information for other disciplines

- Distill high-level feature requests into meaningful, actionable work items and delegate effectively to the team

- Deliver core gameplay features efficiently and on time, and speak up when the team is overor under-scoped

- Lead the vision for different gameplay systems and features and write code and do system design as needed

- Propose and review technical design, systems, and technical approaches to ensure that they satisfy requirements and promote a healthy codebase

- Work closely with art and design leads to ensure gameplay mechanics meet functional requirements and uphold our high standards

- Work closely with other programming disciplines to integrate systems in support of the player experience

What we're looking for

- Experience developing gameplay physics systems (simulation, collision, character/vehicle physics, etc.)

- Experience with network replication systems (client-server prediction, state synchronization, lag compensation)

- Proven track record delivering live-service games or AAA MMO titles built on Unreal Engine

- Proven leadership experience managing high-performing programming teams on shipped AAA titles

- Strong C++ skills and the ability to code and design gameplay mechanics and tools

- Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, as well as the ability to collaborate and communicate to work cross-functionally and give/receive constructive feedback

- Experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code) to improve development efficiency and streamline programming workflows

- Work closely with technical animators, Leads, Directors, and Outsource Managers on the team to ensure assets are set up for success in the different stages of production

postings.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.
ENGINEERING - GAMES

What We Do

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

As foundation models move from answering questions to acting over long horizons, memory becomes a central requirement. Systems must decide what is worth keeping and improve from experience. Large context windows and retrieval systems are not enough. You will work with researchers on projects across the company that require memory in different modalities to define general solutions that enable models to represent experience, decide what they keep and what they discard, and to efficiently store, retrieve and exploit memory.

In this role, you will

- Design new memory architectures that work across problems, modalities and products

- Define new ways to measure and evaluate memory performance

- Help create and deliver production-ready, scalable and high-quality learning models and associated algorithms

- Critically assess the effectiveness of such models and make recommendations for the ongoing roadmap

What we're looking for

- PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics or related field, or 3+ years of relevant industry experience

- Experience creating machine learning algorithms for vision and/or language problems and deploying them as production-level systems

- Expert, hands-on knowledge of:

- Foundational models and vision and/or language, incl. local deployment and model post-training of open weights models

- Memory, state, or long-horizon behaviour in foundation models: your experience may come from language agents and long-context methods, reinforcement learning under partial observability, world models, or sequence modelling

- Python and associated ML tools/frameworks (numpy, scipy, sklearn, pytorch)

- Experience with working collaboratively with other developers, following a flexible and agile approach

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits except for PMI (for dependents). Our current benefits package includes pension, private medical insurance, health care cash plan, dental insurance, disability and life insurance, critical illness, cycle to work scheme, flu shots, health checks, and meals. ENGINEERING - EPIC RESEARCH

What We Do

Epic Research conducts state-of-the-art research in machine learning, AI, character animation, and digital humans. We work with leading universities and product teams to bring new research into games like Fortnite, Unreal Engine, MetaHuman, and the tools creators use every day.

MACHINE LEARNING RESEARCH INTERNSHIP AT EPIC GAMES

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for current PhD students and recent PhD graduates (within 12 months of graduation) for paid research internships, working on state-of-the-art machine learning across our ecosystem. Epic makes Unreal Engine, which powers creative work across many industries, alongside some of the world's most popular games, including Fortnite and Rocket League. Through these products, ML research at Epic reaches millions of creators and players every day. AI is reshaping the games industry, and Epic Research - led by Lucia Specia and Michael Black - is at the center of that shift. We're looking for talented interns who want to be part of it.

In this role, you will

Work with our team of research scientists and engineers at the intersection of vision, language, speech processing, embodied agents, and game development to create state-of-the-art machine learning models in a range of areas - research topics of interest include:

- AI-backed interactive characters: LLMs for conversational characters, memory systems, automated evals, animation, etc.

- Game agents: vision-language-action, game-state agents, etc.

- 3D human and object tracking

- Reinforcement learning for embodied behavior

- Speech systems and conversational agents

- World building and game logic generation: video models, 2D->3D scene building, etc.

- AI-assisted game development, e.g. the next generation of Epic Developer Assistant for UE and UEFN

- Embodied and physical intelligence including human-object interaction

- Multi-modal diffusion models

- Player safety: AI-alignment, content moderation, etc.

- Improved user experience: personalised game recommendation, game representation, spam detection, etc.

- Content localization: (multimodal) translation, quality assurance, etc.

- Model distillation for realtime performance

What we're looking for

- An ongoing or recently completed (within the last 12 months) PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, AI or a related field

- A record of publication in top conferences/journals

- Experience implementing deep learning algorithms for problems in computer vision, natural language processing, or speech/audio processing

- Hands-on knowledge of state-of-the-art ML methods, such as Transformers, diffusion models, and reinforcement learning

- Experience with post-training foundation models, including SFT, preference training, and reinforcement learning

- Excellent AI coding and experimental engineering skills

- Desirable: game development experience in either C++ or C#

Internship Details

- Duration: 5-12 months initially (depending on your location), with flexible start-dates throughout 2026/2027

- Hours: full-time (40 hours/week) or part-time (20 hours/week)

- Location: Select regions within North America and Europe

- Employment Authorization: You must hold an existing right to work in your given location for the full duration of the internship - visa sponsorship or support is unavailable for this role

- Publishing: Research by Epic interns is regularly published in top-tier conferences

postings.description:

PROGRAMMING - GAMES

What We Do

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of programming experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

As foundation models move from answering questions to acting over long horizons, memory becomes a central requirement. Systems must decide what is worth keeping and improve from experience. Large context windows and retrieval systems are not enough. You will work with researchers on projects across the company that require memory in different modalities to define general solutions that enable models to represent experience, decide what they keep and what they discard, and to efficiently store, retrieve and exploit memory.

In this role, you will

- Design new memory architectures that work across problems, modalities and products

- Define new ways to measure and evaluate memory performance

- Help create and deliver production-ready, scalable and high-quality learning models and associated algorithms

- Critically assess the effectiveness of such models and make recommendations for the ongoing roadmap

What we're looking for

- PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics or related field, or 3+ years of relevant industry experience

- Experience creating machine learning algorithms for vision and/or language problems and deploying them as production-level systems

- Expert, hands-on knowledge of:

- Foundational models and vision and/or language, incl. local deployment and model post-training of open weights models

- Memory, state, or long-horizon behaviour in foundation models: your experience may come from language agents and long-context methods, reinforcement learning under partial observability, world models, or sequence modelling

- Python and associated ML tools/frameworks (numpy, scipy, sklearn, pytorch)

- Experience with working collaboratively with other developers, following a flexible and agile approach

- Own gameplay animation from initial concept through implementation in Unreal Engine 5, with a focus on gameplay feel, responsiveness, style, and visual appeal

- Independently come up with new gameplay ideas, build playable prototypes, and iterate on them through playtesting. Bring a strong sense of what makes Fortnite fun and where there's room to take it in new directions

- Champion AI-assisted animation technologies and emerging workflows, identifying opportunities to enhance animation quality, creativity, and production efficiency

- Experiment with, prototype, and help integrate innovative animation tools and techniques into Fortnite's animation pipelines

- Serve as a subject matter expert in gameplay animation, providing creative and technical direction across teams while remaining deeply hands-on

- Partner closely with Design, Engineering, Technical Animation, Technical Design, and Production to solve complex animation challenges and influence long-term animation strategies

- Establish best practices, mentor animators, and raise the bar for animation quality, technical execution, and workflow innovation

- Create and refine stylized and realistic gameplay animation in Unreal Engine 5 using Control Rig and Animation Blueprints

What we're looking for

- Extensive AAA game development experience and a strong portfolio that demonstrates exceptional keyframed gameplay animation for both characters and creatures

- Demonstrated hands-on experience exploring, prototyping, or applying AI-assisted animation technologies and emerging workflows, whether through professional work, independent projects, or personal experimentation

- Strong curiosity and passion for emerging technologies, with a track record of independently exploring new tools and techniques to advance animation workflows

- Deep expertise in Unreal Engine 5, Control Rig, Animation Blueprints, and modern gameplay animation pipelines

- Strong technical understanding of animation systems, including state machines, blending, procedural animation, and runtime implementation

- Proven ability to influence animation direction, establish best practices, and solve complex creative and technical challenges across teams

- Exceptional understanding of animation fundamentals, gameplay responsiveness, timing, and stylized movement

- Experience collaborating across Animation, Engineering, Design, and Technical Animation to deliver scalable animation solutions

- Strong creative and technical problem-solving skills, with the ability to prototype and evaluate new approaches to gameplay animation

- Experience mentoring and elevating other animators through feedback, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance

postings.title: Principal Backend Programmer (Developer Platform)
postings.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.
ONLINE INFRASTRUCTURE

What We Do

We enable Epic’s online services teams to build, deploy, and manage services that are used by more than half a billion players around the world. Our mission is to provide world class tools and platforms to improve the experience of our developers and make it easier, faster, and safer to build, operate, and scale their applications. We operate at massive scale as one of the largest cloud computing users in the world.

What You'll Do

You'll be the senior technical voice across Epic's developer platform: the source control, CI/CD, build, artifact, database and cloud infrastructure that teams across Epic use to build and ship their work. You'll look at problems across systems and teams, and set the technical strategy for where the platform needs to go. The primary focus of this role is rebuilding and scaling our systems to handle millions of agentic CICD actions per day. You'll work across teams to understand their requirements and usage patterns, negotiate trade-offs with cost and feasibility in mind, and build and deploy the changes needed. Beyond that, this is a role for someone we can point at a hard, ambiguous problem in any domain or team and trust to understand it, decide what to do, and get it solved, whether that means designing the system and building it yourself, or bringing the right people together. - Develop and communicate FamXP strategy to the executive audience

- Define metrics that matter, strengthen instrumentation where the signal is weak, and guide the team to ground decisions in data

- Navigate a fast-evolving global regulatory landscape, partnering closely with legal and policy to translate new obligations into product deliverables (often on tight timelines)

- 6+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning complex, cross-product, or platform initiatives

- Direct, hands-on experience partnering with legal, regulatory, or compliance teams, ideally in a regulated industry

- Structured thinker who can bring clarity and momentum to an ambiguous problem space

In this role, you will

- Develop new practices and structures to better scale release management and stabilization processes across our Game Dev ecosystem, while managing a sub-team of release managers

- Own the scheduling, coordination, quality control, and external certification process across multiple platforms and/or products

- Act as the liaison between multiple development teams, coordinating and negotiating development plans, exceptions, sales/mktg/publishing content, as well as releases

- Work with the publishing and development teams to determine release content plans as related to sales, giveaways, promotions, etc., and shepherd that content through external party approvals for release

- Work closely with QA, Build Engineers, and Lead Programmers to monitor the automated build and integration process, facilitate the resolution of build failures, and understand and communicate the impact of branches and code merges

- Partner with QA Leads to establish and maintain the bug triage process and prioritize must-fix issues, coordinate internal and external release notes, known issues, and knowledge base updates, and ensure releases have passed all required checks and approvals leading up to live deployment, while communicating approved exceptions to all necessary parties

What we're looking for

- Strong production/project management skills, communication skills, and people management/direct report experience

- Demonstrated ability in right-sized process development and improvement

- Experience with build and release processes for Software or Games as a Service product

- Familiar with Perforce, Jira, Grafana, AirTable

- Exposure to platform certification processes

- Technical orientation and a strong understanding of software development

- Knowledge of the game development process and exposure to working with shipped and live titles

The Quality Assurance team owns the testing process, risk management, and quality evaluation of all products and functions across Epic. Our team works closely with developers and production to ensure the best possible user experience for our community and customers.

SDET INTERN

What You'll Do

Epic Games Art Ops team is looking for a smart, creative Software Development Engineer in Test Intern. Art Ops is the team that builds the tools, pipelines, and Al workflows our artists use for game development and emerging tech every day. This role focuses on testing those internal tools and frameworks; you'll embed with our team of engineers and technical artists to help design and build everything from Cl pipelines, test plans, and integration tests for our web apps to checks that tell us how well our Al tools are performing.

In this role, you will

- Write test plans for new tools and features, then turn them into automated tests

- Help design and build the test framework our team will use going forward, with our engineers reviewing your code

- Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for our web apps and pipeline tools

- Test how Al tools and workflows perform when new models are released, and help build ways to measure their performance

- Support weekly release testing and turn repeated manual checks into automated tests

- Investigate test failures, determine why a test broke, and share results with the team

- Use Al-assisted tools to help run, write, and triage tests, and review what they produce

What we're looking for

- Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or a related field

- Comfortable writing code in at least one modern OOP language such as Python, C++, or C#, through coursework or personal projects

- Basic understanding of software testing, such as unit and integration testing

- Familiarity with a version control system

- Interest in Al for content and code generation

- Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to confidently collaborate with senior team members and take feedback on technical topics and features

- Willingness to dive into new things and drive them forward

- A personal project repository or demo portfolio is required

- Some experience with test frameworks like Jest, Pytest, or Playwright, Cl systems like GitHub Actions, or Al evaluation tools like LangChain or DeepEval is desired

- Exposure to art tools such as Unreal Engine, Maya, or Houdini, or interest in how artists work is highly desired

ONLINE INFRASTRUCTURE

What We Do

We enable Epic’s online services teams to build, deploy, and manage services that are used by more than half a billion players around the world. Our mission is to provide world class tools and platforms to improve the experience of our developers and make it easier, faster, and safer to build, operate, and scale their applications. We operate at massive scale as one of the largest cloud computing users in the world.

What You'll Do

You'll own the backend systems behind Epic's CI/CD and build tooling and the cloud infrastructure they run on. These systems carry code from commit to production for teams across Epic, so they need to be fast, reliable and secure. Your primary focus is software supply chain security: securing the pipelines, runners and artifact stores that build and ship our software, working closely with our security and governance teams. This is a hands-on technical lead role. You'll spend most of your time building and running systems yourself, while helping set the team's technical direction, architecture and goals. Epic is an agentic-programming-first company. You'll be expected to use Al coding tools and agents as a normal part of how you work, and help shape how we apply them to our own infrastructure.

In this role, you will

- Design, build and operate the backend infrastructure for our CI/CD and artifact platforms on AWS and GCP

- Lead software supply chain security work, including vulnerability scanning, artifact signing and provenance, and hardening of build runners and agents

- Partner with security and governance teams on controls, audits and compliance requirements, and turn them into practical changes to tools and pipelines

- Help set technical direction for the platform: weigh in on design, priorities and longer-term goals, and document the decisions

- Guide and review the work of a team of contractors, setting clear tasks and standards and keeping the work moving

- Automate wherever possible, with infrastructure as code, self-service tooling and workflows that reduce manual work

- Improve the reliability, scale and observability of the build platform, troubleshoot hard production issues, and take part in incident response

- Use AI coding tools and agentic workflows in your own work, and help apply them to how the team builds and runs its systems

What we're looking for

- Strong experience running cloud infrastructure on AWS (experience with GCP or Azure is also welcome)

- Experience deploying and maintaining environments with infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar) and configuration management tools

- Hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production

- Experience operating CI/CD and version control systems at scale, such as Lore, GitHub Actions, TeamCity, Codefresh, Jenkins, GitHub, GitLab or Perforce

- Working knowledge of software supply chain security: vulnerability scanning, artifact and container registries, secrets management, and hardening build infrastructure

- Strong scripting and programming skills in Python, Go, Bash or similar

- Comfortable with Al coding tools and agentic programming, and interested in how far they can be pushed in infrastructure work

- Experience leading technical work, such as making design decisions, mentoring programmers, or directing contractors or vendors

- Excellent communicator, able to work across security, governance and programming teams

- Experience with security or compliance frameworks in a large organization would be a plus

This role is open to multiple locations in North America (including CA & WA).

postings.description:

ANALYTICS

What We Do

Our Data & Analytics teams build powerful stories and visuals that inform the games we make, the technology we develop, and business decisions that drive Epic.

What You'll Do

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist, Transparency and Regulatory, to join the Analytics team, where you will own the data and drive data tooling behind transparency reports Epic publishes under regulations such as the DSA, and support risk assessments, audits, compliance assessments, and other compliance reporting. You'll work with Legal, Compliance, Trust and Safety, and data engineering to turn regulatory requirements into clear metric definitions, bring in the figures other teams hold, and check every number before it is published.

In this role, you will

- Own the data for transparency reports, risk assessments, and other compliance reporting across our products like Fortnite, the Epic Games Store, and Fab; from data requests to published figures

- Work with Legal, Compliance, Engineering, and Trust and Safety policy teams to turn regulatory text into productionalized metric definitions

- Map Epic's internal moderation data to regulatory categories, and work with product and engineering teams so new features capture what a regulatory report may need before launch

- Partner with Data Engineering to drive the templates and validation tooling that other teams use to submit their data

- Review the reporting pipeline's data quality checks every month, and work with Data Engineering to fix drift and defects, and add new moderation flows

- Drive reporting methodology in partnership with leadership across the company

What we're looking for

- 5+ years of professional experience as a Data Scientist or in a related field, including 2+ years with Trust and Safety, integrity, risk, compliance, or regulatory reporting data

- Expertise with SQL, Python, and big data technologies such as Spark or Databricks

- Experience turning legal, policy, or regulatory language into precise metric definitions, documented well enough for someone else to audit

- Hands-on work on transparency reports or similar regulatory reporting (DSA, COPPA, audits, etc), delivering a recurring, deadline-bound report that depends on data from other teams

- Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience writing data specifications for engineers and presenting to Legal, Compliance, and senior leadership

- Experience with content moderation or child safety data, such as notices, appeals, statements of reasons, or age assurance

- Experience supporting an internal audit, a controls review, or a regulator's request for information

- Experience with data visualization, code version control (GitHub or similar), and orchestration (Airflow or similar)

- Experience using Al in daily data work and building Al tools or agents for documentation, reconciliation, or review work

- Passion for the gaming industry

DESIGN

Put your design skills to work at a cutting-edge company that challenges the norm. From character and level design to competitive gameplay and system design, help shape the future of interactive entertainment at Epic.

What You'll Do

As the Senior Director of Design focusing on Fortnite, you will be responsible for leading and collaborating with a multidisciplinary team of developers to guide Fortnite modes to success from ideation to ship. Working with senior leadership, you will carry the game's vision and Epic’s goals forward while making hard calls on quality and priorities, and, above all, be creatively excited and engaged in creating an unforgettable, fun experience for our players.

In this role, you will

- Collaborate with senior leadership to define a vision and business goals for a season within Fortnite Battle Royale, Reload, and more shooter modes.

- Manage a design team and hone the design craft for Fortnite.

- Hold that design vision across the company with clarity and excitement, and inspire the design team to follow you; uphold Epic’s design and gameplay quality bar

- Oversee design and development from start to finish - From leading ideation with the team and shaping a timeline of engagement across the whole season, to making tough decisions on quality and scope throughout production

- Establish a design roadmap that drives multiple seasons, along with system roadmaps that underpin those seasons.

- Work with Product Managers and Analytics teams to gain insights from player metrics and marketplace data, then translate those insights into actionable goals to improve the player experience; work with Production, discipline leads, and HR to manage staffing, feature scope, production milestones, and hiring

- Focus on mentoring and empowering the design team to be independently successful and make solid decisions without your involvement; foster curiosity and healthy risk-taking

What we're looking for

- Experience leading game teams from a director or other high-level design leadership perspective

- Rich background in game systems that operate at scale.

- An expert-level background in a creative craft you can speak to and draw from

- A deep understanding of what makes games tick at all levels, with a particular focus on what makes them fun, immersive experiences

- Passion and excitement for applying yourself to highly complicated problem spaces

- Experience leading game teams from a director or other high-level design leadership perspective
