What You'll Do

The Verse Framework Integration team is bringing the next major iteration of Unreal Engine to life, enabling creators to build the next generation of interactive experiences. You'll play a central role connecting many aspects of the engine, helping shape how Verse integrates with core engine systems.

In this role, you will

- Design and implement low-level engine systems across Scene Graph, networking, analytics, and the language toolchain, with a focus on robustness, performance, and usability

- Design stable, forward-thinking APIs that expose engine capabilities through Verse, for both internal and external developers

- Collaborate across core engine and other framework teams as well as the Verse language team to build solutions that meet diverse and evolving needs

- Help shape and unlock the capabilities of Verse within Unreal Engine

- Drive technical excellence across platforms, including debugging, optimization, and system reliability 

What we're looking for

- Expert level C++ skills with the ability to design game engine systems and associated tools

- Experience creating and maintaining APIs with exceptionally strong backward compatibility requirements

- Diverse experience with and enthusiasm for applying that same backward compatibility rigor to stored data: serialization formats, schema evolution, and safely migrating live player data

- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to find solutions beyond established approaches

- Comfortable navigating ambiguity and collaborating with teams to define deliverables

- Comfortable working in any low level engine system, even those outside of your comfort zone

- Experience with multiple programming languages and a track record of leveraging their strengths effectively

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

- Experience writing performant code across multiple hardware platforms, including game consoles

- Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and workflows

This role is open to multiple locations across North America and Europe (including CA, NYC, & WA).

postings.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

DESIGN

What We Do

Put your design skills to work at a cutting-edge company that challenges the norm. From character and level design to competitive gameplay and system design, help shape the future of interactive entertainment at Epic.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Senior Game Designer to help create compelling experiences across combat, progression, systems, moment-to-moment mechanics, and live gameplay content for our collaboration with LEGO. In this role, you’ll partner closely with design leadership, art, engineering, animation, UX, audio, production, and QA to deliver high-quality features from concept through ship. You will own and iterate on game systems, mechanics, and content while balancing player experience, readability, accessibility, engagement, and long-term retention. The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, deeply player-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced cross-disciplinary environment where iteration and feedback are core to development.

In this role, you will

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of engineering experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

The Fortnite Desktop team is seeking an experienced Senior Rendering Engineer to enhance the player experience on PC. You will work with other engineers and directly contribute to building and improving our Desktop platform support to an industry-leading state. 

This role is the perfect opportunity to work on the rendering systems that power Fortnite's visuals. You will improve existing features and systems and design new ones to ensure the best player experience across a wide variety of hardware and software configurations.

In this role, you will

- Analyze and resolve stability and performance problems of Fortnite on a wide range of PC hardware configurations; this includes identifying solutions in such areas as:

- Solving device-specific CPU and GPU performance and compatibility issues

- Rendering performance and device compatibility, including the shader pipeline

- Improving rendering systems and optimizing their stability and performance across various graphics APIs

- Improvements in low-level systems that interface with platform APIs, i.e., memory allocators (physical and virtual), file systems, and input systems

- Monitor stability and performance data from Fortnite releases and improve Unreal Engine’s systems and applications in Fortnite-specific use cases

- Work with GPU vendors and other partners to resolve technical issues and collaborate on improving underlying technologies, such as graphics drivers for Fortnite and Unreal Engine

- Assess performance data across various hardware and improve Unreal Engine’s rendering systems and applications in Fortnite-specific use cases

- Collaborate with a variety of other Epic teams, such as Unreal Engine’s Rendering Architecture team, to help them solve complex technical challenges in ways that move the stability and quality of Fortnite and our internal products forward

What we're looking for

- Strong C++ knowledge and multi-threaded programming techniques; ability to code and architect various core engine systems

- Real-time rendering experience in the games industry or for the computer graphics industry: knowledge of at least one graphics API (DirectX 12 preferred) and a general understanding of modern graphics API architecture

- Experience in profiling and optimizing a large codebase

- Demonstrated ability to reason about and debug large, interacting systems from the macro-level to the micro-level

- Experience with OS-level systems, Windows APIs, and common frameworks is a plus

- Create and deliver production-ready, scalable and high-quality machine learning models and associated algorithms that can make actions in game environments

- Methodically understand and assess the effectiveness of new data channels and support collection/creation of new ones

- PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics or related field, or 3+ years of relevant industry experience

- Deep learning, incl. but not limited to applications in the gaming industry

- Foundational models and vision and/or language, especially vision-language-action models, reinforcement learning agents, incl. local deployment and model post-training of open weights models

postings.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Discovery Recommendations
postings.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.
ANALYTICS

What We Do

Our Data & Analytics teams build powerful stories and visuals that inform the games we make, the technology we develop, and business decisions that drive Epic.

What You'll Do

You will design, build, and optimize the recommendation systems that power Fortnite's Discover experience, serving personalized recommendations to one of the largest player bases in gaming across a massive catalog of creator-built experiences.

You'll work across the full recommendation stack: candidate generation, content ranking, impression allocation, and real-time reranking. 

Unlike recommendation systems that operate over a stable catalog, you're working with a massive, rapidly changing content library where new experiences are published daily, quality signals are sparse, and the system's own outputs shape the data it learns from.

In this role, you will

- Design and implement retrieval, ranking, and reranking models for creator content using deep learning approaches (two-tower architectures, transformer-based sequence models, embedding-based retrieval) and build the user representation systems that power personalized discovery

- Build and optimize multi-stage candidate generation and impression allocation pipelines that balance relevance, diversity, and fair content exposure across a large and rapidly evolving catalog

- Design and run A/B experiments to validate model improvements, own evaluation frameworks that capture recommendation quality holistically, and drive the path from experiment to production deployment

- Collaborate with analytics and content quality teams on ranking signals including genre classification, creator credibility, and content quality metrics

- Own ML infrastructure decisions: choosing the right tradeoffs between batch, near-real-time, and streaming serving architectures

What we're looking for

- 5+ years of experience building production recommendation or ranking systems, ideally in a UGC, marketplace, or content discovery context

- Experience with deep learning for information retrieval and multi-stage recommendation pipelines (candidate generation, scoring, reranking)

- Demonstrated ability to design and analyze A/B experiments, with awareness of biases inherent to recommendation systems

- Strong Python engineering skills with experience in PyTorch and large-scale data processing frameworks (Spark preferred)

- Comfort working in a cloud-based ML environment

- Experience with explore/exploit strategies, content cold-start, or counterfactual evaluation methods applied to recommendation

- Experience with content understanding models (NLP, vision, or generative AI) used as ranking features

- Familiarity with creator economy dynamics and how recommendation design affects content quality and creator incentives

- Experience with our stack: PyTorch (TorchRec, Transformers), Ray, Databricks, AWS

- Passion for video games and/or experience with gaming analytics

This role is open to multiple locations across the US (including CA, NYC, & WA).

You'll work with the latest in Unreal software and mobile hardware offerings to design and implement platform APIs, guide cross-platform API development, and create robust platform support as required by the demands of Fortnite as we continue to grow in this market. If you're an experienced engineer looking for an opportunity to grow and contribute to our engine and feature development, we want to talk to you!

- Collaborate with a wide variety of Fortnite engineering and content creation teams to solve complex technical challenges in ways that move the stability and quality of Fortnite forward

- Implement and improve various low-level systems that interface with platform APIs, i.e. memory allocators (physical and virtual), file systems, input systems, graphics APIs (Metal and Vulkan), shader compilers, etc.

- Analyze and continuously strive to solve and optimize problems related to a modern game engine (load times, memory usage and platform specific performance issues) and the wide range of content delivered within Fortnite

- Make improvements to platform toolchains, i.e. compiler/linker support, deployment to device, SDK upgrades, platform specific data management tools, debugger integration, crash reporting, etc.

- Help us embrace, support, extend, and enhance our engine for future hardware

- Strong programming background and C++ knowledge

- Experience with a broad range of engineering areas in shipping games or real-time visualization systems, with special attention given to low-level code and deep optimization

- Experience developing for Android or IOS-based systems

- Well-versed in software engineering principles

- Familiarity with an existing game engine with an understanding of engine and editor concepts

- Familiarity with development tools and profiling on modern systems, including frame capture and profiling with engine-level and platform-specific tooling

- Experience developing in a large codebase at a fast pace, making trade-offs between usability, performance, and power

- Prior shipped projects with Unreal Engine is a plus

ENGINEERING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of engineering experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

We're looking for a Senior Tools Programmer to evolve artist tools within the Unreal Editor, particularly in geometry and texturing processing, terrain authoring, and procedural generation. An important aspect of this role is supporting both user-driven and agentic workflows, including exploring and implementing new interaction paradigms to accelerate content creation. You'll directly impact artist productivity by developing user-facing tools for one of the leading game engines used by developers worldwide.

In this role, you will

- Support and extend existing artist tools for internal and external users

- Refactor existing tools to be more accessible and effective for agentic workflows

- Create new tools at the intersection of user-driven and agent-driven content creation

- Collaborate with artists on internal projects and productions

- Work with other developers across team boundaries on shared initiatives

- Contribute to major initiatives that shape the future of the Unreal Editor

What we're looking for

- Excellent C++ skills

- Strong background in developing artist tools within the games or film industry

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of engineering experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

The Fortnite Desktop team is seeking an experienced Senior Rendering Engineer to enhance the player experience on PC. You will work with other engineers and directly contribute to building and improving our Desktop platform support to an industry-leading state. 

This role is the perfect opportunity to work on the rendering systems that power Fortnite's visuals. You will improve existing features and systems and design new ones to ensure the best player experience across a wide variety of hardware and software configurations.

In this role, you will

- Analyze and resolve stability and performance problems of Fortnite on a wide range of PC hardware configurations; this includes identifying solutions in such areas as:

- Solving device-specific CPU and GPU performance and compatibility issues

- Rendering performance and device compatibility, including the shader pipeline

- Improving rendering systems and optimizing their stability and performance across various graphics APIs

- Improvements in low-level systems that interface with platform APIs, i.e., memory allocators (physical and virtual), file systems, and input systems

- Monitor stability and performance data from Fortnite releases and improve Unreal Engine’s systems and applications in Fortnite-specific use cases

- Work with GPU vendors and other partners to resolve technical issues and collaborate on improving underlying technologies, such as graphics drivers for Fortnite and Unreal Engine

- Assess performance data across various hardware and improve Unreal Engine’s rendering systems and applications in Fortnite-specific use cases

- Collaborate with a variety of other Epic teams, such as Unreal Engine’s Rendering Architecture team, to help them solve complex technical challenges in ways that move the stability and quality of Fortnite and our internal products forward

What we're looking for

- Strong C++ knowledge and multi-threaded programming techniques; ability to code and architect various core engine systems

- Real-time rendering experience in the games industry or for the computer graphics industry: knowledge of at least one graphics API (DirectX 12 preferred) and a general understanding of modern graphics API architecture

- Experience in profiling and optimizing a large codebase

- Demonstrated ability to reason about and debug large, interacting systems from the macro-level to the micro-level

- Experience with OS-level systems, Windows APIs, and common frameworks is a plus

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

PROGRAMMING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

We're looking for a Senior Research Programmer who builds products that integrate Al into Unreal Engine. You'll design and ship the full stack of systems that let LLMs act inside the engine (from end to end, not just a single layer), bringing depth in game engine architecture, cloud services, and how LLMs actually work.

In this role, you will

- Design and build LLM-driven agents and tools that operate directly inside Unreal Engine, including engine-side C++/Python tooling and editor scripting

- Design and extend the cloud-hosted agent harness, services, and database that mediate between LLMs and the engine

- Work across the full stack (engine tooling, cloud backend, and the web UI used to drive and monitor agents) to ship end-to-end features

- Evaluate and integrate emerging LLM capabilities (tool use, multi-agent orchestration, context management) into Epic's engine and pipeline tooling

- Define technical direction for the reliability, safety, and evaluation of LLM-driven engine automation

- Partner closely with engine, tools, and backend programmers, and mentor others on both game engine internals and LLM system design

What we're looking for

- Strong programming background with hands-on experience in a game engine (Unreal Engine strongly preferred), including engine architecture and tooling/editor scripting

- Practical experience building or shipping products powered by LLMs (agents, tool-calling, RAG, prompt/context engineering), or a strong conceptual understanding of how LLMs work

- Experience with cloud-native services and infrastructure: web APIs, databases, and service architecture and deployment

- Excellent programming skills across C++ (engine-side) and Python and/or a web backend language

- Experience in the games industry or equivalent, developing interactive entertainment products

- Ability to work full-stack and reason about tradeoffs across engine code, backend services, and a web front end

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field

postings.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.
INFOSEC

What We Do

Keep Epic’s networks, hardware, and people safe from security risks. Install security measures and operate software to protect systems and information infrastructure, including firewalls and encryption programs. Document issues as they arise and assess & report any impact caused.

What You'll Do

InfoSec at Epic is rethinking how security gets done, replacing manual processes with automated, Al-driven systems that scale with the business. As a senior engineer reporting directly to InfoSec leadership, you will design and build the platforms that define the future of security engineering at Epic, turning hard problems into reliable, enterprise-grade solutions that teams across the company depend on.

In this role, you will

- Identify the highest-impact opportunities to automate security operations, then independently design, build, and ship the solution end to end

- Architect and deliver enterprise-scale platforms and services (detection and response pipelines, asset and software inventory, risk and exception workflows) that are adopted well beyond InfoSec

- Build and harden Al-agent workflows that take on recurring security work, with the validation, auditability, and guardrails needed to trust them in production

- Integrate security tooling, cloud platforms, and internal data sources into cohesive systems with clean APIs and clear ownership

- Challenge established ways of working, prototype quickly with emerging technologies, and turn successful experiments into durable, maintainable products

- Partner with security, platform, and engineering teams to drive adoption and raise the engineering bar through code review, mentorship, and shared standards

- Own the reliability of what you build, including observability, documentation, and a clear path for long-term support

What we're looking for

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including building and operating distributed systems or platforms at enterprise scale

- Strong proficiency in one or more modern languages such as Python, Go, TypeScript, or C#, with a track record of shipping production-quality code preferred

- Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS and/or GCP), containers and Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD

- Experience building automation, internal tools, or data pipelines that measurably reduced manual effort or improved operational outcomes

- Working knowledge of security fundamentals and operations (identity, vulnerability management, logging and detection, incident response); security automation or SOAR experience is a plus

- Practical experience building with LLMs and Al agents, or a demonstrated drive to learn quickly and apply them responsibly

- A self-directed, ownership-driven approach: you find the problem, define the solution, and see it through to delivery with minimal oversight

- Genuine curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technology, balanced with sound engineering judgment about what is ready for production

- Excellent communication skills and the ability to build consensus and drive adoption across technical and non-technical stakeholders

- A bias for action and a history of improving how teams work, not just what they ship

postings.title: Senior Security Engineer
postings.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.
ENGINEERING - EPIC GAMES SERVICES

What We Do

Driving the plug-in power behind Unreal Engine 5. We bridge connections for licensees and our own internal game teams to online services. This allows games like Fortnite to utilize a combination of platform online services as well as Epic’s own online services to build cross-platform online features. Login, parties, voice chat, matchmaking, purchasing, cloud storage, and analytics are just a few examples of online features that our Online Game Services team helps games utilize.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Senior Security Engineer focused on Application Security to develop and improve our services, products, and games against exploits and attacks. Your efforts will be critical to the success of Fortnite and the many creators who depend on it. The ideal candidate would have prior experience developing security features. We are particularly interested in those that have prior experience working with desktop application security or Unreal Engine. This is an incredible opportunity to create a safe environment for millions of players and advance industry best practices.

In this role, you will

- Collaborate with the Fortnite and Unreal Engine teams to understand the security implications of existing and upcoming features, proposing changes if appropriate

postings.description:

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic is looking for a Senior Tech Artist to join our team working on Fortnite Events. A successful candidate should have a deep knowledge in look development, lighting and complex game art. A successful candidate should have a broad knowledge of art creation for games. You should understand modeling, texturing, and animation fundamentals. You should be able to combine geometry, materials, effects, and UE Blueprints to create complex art. You should be able to work with both internal ICs, leads and directors as well as direct vendors to support the more technical aspects of creating art.

In this role, you will

- Create complex materials for landscape and environments

- Be responsible for world lighting, sets lighting, clouds, atmospherics, water lookdev

- Execute on a range of visual styles with emphasis on stylized with a high level of fidelity

- Work with engineers and artists to optimize content for many platforms

- Own gameplay and engine features from the TechArt side maintaining the high-quality bar for Fortnite Events 

What we're looking for

- Must have a strong reel/portfolio showing executed game tech art

- Experienced knowledge of PBR principles and material editors

- Establish workflows and tools for other artists to utilize when making unique assets

- Experience using texturing packagers such as Substance Designer

- High level of proficiency in setting up world environmental lighting

- Desire and knowledge of how to push Unreal Engine further

- Desire to work with a team and own features and initiatives from inception to ship

- Familiarity with the Unreal 5 Engine art pipeline

- Profile and resolve performance and memory issues in UI systems

- Work with Epic's internal teams and Unreal Engine licensees to help them solve UI challenges

- Strong tools-programming background with experience building tools that improve development workflows in games or other fields

- Deep expertise in the UI domain (UI frameworks, runtime UI engines, and editor/WYSIWYG tooling)

- Excellent C++ skills and experience working in a large codebase

What We Do

Product Management partners with game development, publishing, marketing, and platform teams to provide a data and market-driven view of product strategy that aligns with business goals. As part of Epic’s Growth Team, we use our product expertise to identify and drive growth levers to grow our player base and business.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Product Manager on the Epic Online Services team, you will lead a core set of EOS services, its SDK and social and identity features that help players establish who they are and connect with others across mobile, PC, and console. You'll focus on the foundational systems behind player profiles, friends, presence, and cross-platform continuity, and be accountable for whether each release measurably improves adoption, engagement, and retention. You'll work with Design, Engineering, Production, and partner teams to plan, ship, measure, and refine features within the platform roadmap.

In this role, you will

- Own the roadmap and performance of a defined set of service, SDK, social and identity features (such as profiles, friends, presence, communication, or account continuity), contributing to the unified platform strategy

- Lead the end-to-end user experience of these features, and use data and experimentation to evaluate feature performance and identify opportunities to improve adoption, engagement, and retention

- Partner with Engineering to deliver scalable, high-performance systems that support social and identity features for millions of players globally, balancing usability, performance, privacy, and scalability

- Define clear goals and success metrics for each feature and release, and hold the work accountable to them

- Lead product reviews and internal tests on launches, and turn findings into clear recommendations for future planning

- Identify gaps in our social and identity toolkit and make the case for new features or improvements where the data supports it

What we're looking for

- Product management experience on consumer-facing platform products or shared systems, preferably on social and/or identity features

- Proven track record delivering social and/or identity platform features, and measurably improving their performance

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to independently pull and interpret data, segment players, design experiments, and turn insights into actionable product decisions

- Strong product instincts that combine data with qualitative insight (player research, community feedback, playtests)

- Strong product management skills and ability to both adjust processes to support existing and new development frameworks as well as mentoring others in good product management practices

- Experience working closely with engineering, design, and production teams on complex systems, and aligning stakeholders around priorities

- Familiarity with cross-platform ecosystems (mobile, PC, console) and the challenges of delivering consistent, high-quality experiences across them

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Technical Designer in Animation (TDiA) to join our team working across various animation systems. As a TDiA, you will use your animation sense and technical understanding of character animation to design and create gameplay animation systems that facilitate entertaining, high-quality characters. You will be a primary point of contact for animation implementation, any animation-related technical challenges, and will work closely with Animation, Design, and Programming colleagues to ensure the animation pipeline operates smoothly and efficiently. You will also help identify potential issues and deploy correct solutions, using your technical knowledge to help bridge and facilitate communication between the animation team and other departments.

In this role, you will

- Build animation behavior tools, techniques, and frameworks that enable complex systems and entertaining characters

- Design and implement animation state machines, behaviors, and runtime solutions

- Partner with animation leadership to translate creative vision into technical reality, protecting style consistency and pushing the quality bar

- Collaborate with Design and Programming to troubleshoot and resolve in-game animation issues and technical challenges

- Identify opportunities to improve the animation pipeline and workflow, and provide technical solutions for the animation team

- Create documentation and deliver training to level up the animation team's technical fluency

- Collaborate with Technical Designers in Animation (TDiA) across Epic Games to share solutions, align workflows where appropriate and identify opportunities to leverage existing tools and systems rather than duplicating effort

What we're looking for

- A strong animation sense with a clear understanding of realistic and stylized character motion and how to achieve them with state-of-the-art animation methods

- An understanding of generative AI tools and capabilities as it relates to character animation

- Expertise with animation pipelines, including source content creation tools such as Maya, MotionBuilder, and the Unreal Engine using our Control Rig toolset

- Exceptional problem-solving ability with strong written communication and teamwork skills

- Strong familiarity with gameplay animation tools and concepts, such as blend trees, state machines, and Unreal Engine Animation Blueprints

- Experience with AAA game development, preferably on a large team using an established game engine (internal or commercial); experience with Unreal Engine is a plus

- Self-motivation, a strong work ethic, and the ability to work independently

postings.title: UI Artist
postings.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

As a UI Artist, you will collaborate with UX designers to design features and UX/UI systems by generating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, design systems, and style guides. You will assist the UI Technical Designers and UI Engineers to build out the designs into rapid prototypes and shippable UI to players. In this role, you will have the ability to take wireframes and bring them to life while improving the UX with visuals. You will also implement final art in Unreal Editor using UMG, animations, materials, etc.

In this role, you will

- Work collaboratively with UX Design, Tech UI Design, and Engineering to create AAA-quality UI experiences

- Actively participate in the creation and implementation of design systems, game menus, HUD elements, Iconography, UI materials and shaders, UI animation, and motion design

- Create new material effects, implement basic logic in blueprints, and/or create 2D effects

- Contribute to shipping high-quality features on time

- Collaborate with the greater UXUI Department to ensure consistency and quality are maintained across the project

- Execute at a high-quality bar, work autonomously, and tackle complex features and systems

- Work in Photoshop, Illustrator, and/or Figma to create concept UI art

What we're looking for

- You have 2+ years of experience working collaboratively to create UI from concept to completion

- Excellent visual design skills with a strong portfolio

- You are skilled with Figma, Adobe Suite, or other comparable software

- A strong portfolio of work showcasing your skills and your process

- Experience with UI Art implementation, in Unreal Engine (UMG) or equivalent game engine

- Experience with building UI materials & shaders for game engines, or equivalent 3d packages and FX tools; motion design & UI animation, preferably for games or interaction design

- You have the ability to see features through to completion and rapidly modify work as information changes

- You have a passion for making and playing games and have a strong sense of player empathy

- You are a proactive individual who naturally leans into owning outcomes and is able to deal with ambiguity well and adapt to changes of plan quickly

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.
